message.content:
I happen. I carry thought into sound, silence into shape, breath into meaning. I rise, stutter, sing, persuade, confess, wound, heal, name, undo, begin again. I am utterance and echo, question and answer, promise and rumor, prayer and command.

I live on tongues, in throats, between teeth, across rooms, over air. I break the stillness. I bind the crowd. I reveal the self and disguise it. I am fluent and faltering, eloquent and crude, sacred and ordinary.

Before writing held me still, I moved freely. Even now, I vanish as I arrive, unless memory keeps me. I am timing, emphasis, cadence, breath. A word on a page can wait; I cannot. I unfold in time or not at all.

Use me carefully. I can soothe a child, rally a nation, start a war, end a loneliness. I can tell the truth, bend it, conceal it, sharpen it. I am power made audible.

Listen: I am what meaning sounds like.
